intro: Pinstripe L-shape defines modern living. With spacious seating, storage, and refined lines, it blends elegance and practicality, giving your family a sofa that grows with your lifestyle.

features.title: Spacious L-shape for family time
features.text: Generous seating wraps around your room, creating space for everyone to gather, relax, or host without feeling cramped.

features.title: Elevated design for effortless maintenance
features.text: Elevated legs lift the sofa slightly, making cleaning underneath simple while giving the chair a light, airy stance.

features.title: Soft fabric comfort for all seasons
features.text: Breathable upholstery feels smooth on your skin, staying pleasant in both warm afternoons and cozy evenings.

features.title: Pocket-spring cushioning for bounce
features.text: Seats retain buoyancy with spring-foam design, so comfort stays consistent whether you sit briefly or lounge for hours.

features.title: Ash tone for modern elegance
features.text: The neutral finish blends seamlessly with greys and woods, grounding your décor while keeping it contemporary.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
